key_phrases: strong demand for our 5 nanometer technology
CapEx guidance of $25 billion to $28 billion
structural profitability goal of 50% gross margin
analysis.reasoning: The overall sentiment is highly positive, driven by strong 5nm demand and an upgraded long-term revenue growth target (from 5-10% to 10-15%). Management shows extreme confidence in their technological roadmap (N3/N5) and justifies a massive CapEx increase as a strategic move to capture multi-year mega-trends. While there is some evasiveness regarding specific customer names (e.g., x86, Apple) and exact US fab costs, the quantitative specificity is high with detailed margin drivers and depreciation forecasts. The only moderate risk noted is the supply tightness in mature nodes and the impact of N5 ramping on margins, but this is framed as manageable within their 50% structural margin target.
